snippet.title: M.O.L.E. Trailer
snippet.description:
The deeper you dig, the louder it calls.

M.O.L.E. is a simulator horror experience about madness, ritual, and the depths we choose to dig.

You are the Navigator aboard a deep-bore vessel, a colossal drilling machine sent to pierce the Earth and find something long buried.
The crew is gone. The vessel is silent.
And the Signal won’t stop calling.

Operate failing systems, solve diegetic machinery puzzles, and keep the vessel alive as you descend into impossible depths and into the erosion of your own sanity.

🜏 Fully diegetic simulation.  No menus, only machines.
🜏 Claustrophobic PSX-style horror aesthetic.
🜏 A story of memory, faith, and the cost of discovery.

👉 Now live on Steam

Developed by Off Black Creations
Built in Unreal Engine 5
